description: ExChain — 分手鏈上計算器 & 鏈上關係鎖. Hackathon MVP: Ex-Scanner (wallet scan + breakup calculator + AI roast) + ExChain Lock (smart contract deployment + deposit + withdraw/breakup)

userStories.title: Project scaffold & OnchainOS integration
userStories.description: Set up the project structure with OnchainOS CLI integration. Create the agent entry point that can invoke onchainos commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Project directory structure created: /contracts, /src/agent, /src/reports, /src/utils
OnchainOS CLI wrapper utility that can execute onchainos commands and parse JSON output
Basic config file with API endpoints and default chain settings
TypeScript setup with proper types for OnchainOS responses
Package.json with all dependencies
userStories.notes: Foundation — all other stories depend on this

userStories.title: Ex-Scanner: Wallet portfolio scanning
userStories.description: Implement the Ex-Scanner module that takes a wallet address and returns complete financial overview using OnchainOS portfolio & market skills.
acceptanceCriteria: Function: scanWallet(address, chains[]) that calls onchainos portfolio total-value and all-balances
Function: analyzePnL(address, chain) that calls onchainos market portfolio-overview and portfolio-token-pnl
Function: getTradeHistory(address, chain) that calls onchainos market portfolio-dex-history
All functions return typed interfaces, not raw JSON strings
Error handling for: empty wallets, API timeouts, invalid addresses
Unit tests with mocked OnchainOS responses
userStories.notes: Core data layer for the scanner

userStories.title: Ex-Scanner: Scoring & tagging system
userStories.description: Build the scoring engine that transforms raw wallet data into fun metrics: earning index, risk level, investment style tags, lie index.
acceptanceCriteria: Function: calculateEarningIndex(walletData) → score 0-100 based on total assets + PnL
Function: classifyInvestmentStyle(holdings) → tags: 💎Diamond Hands / 🧻Paper Hands / 🐋Whale / 🦐Shrimp / 🌾DeFi Farmer / 🐶Meme Player / 🎨NFT Collector / 📈Trend Trader
Function: calculateLieIndex(totalAssets, claimedBroke) → percentage 0-100
Function: getSmartMoneyRank(address) using okx-dex-signal leaderboard
All scoring logic is pure functions, easily testable
Unit tests covering edge cases: zero balance, all stablecoins, only meme coins
userStories.notes: This is what makes ExChain fun and viral

userStories.title: Breakup Calculator: Compensation engine
userStories.description: Implement the breakup compensation calculator with configurable parameters: baseRate, profitShareRate, emotionalMultiplier.
acceptanceCriteria: Function: calculateCompensation(params) → { baseComp, profitShare, emotionalDamages, total, breakdown }
Base compensation = ex total assets × baseRate (default 5%)
Profit share = realized PnL during relationship × profitShareRate (default 10%)
Emotional multiplier: winRate > 70% → ×1.5, < 30% → ×0.5, else ×1.0
Relationship period filtering using relationshipStart date
Support for custom rate adjustments (1%-20% base, 0%-50% profit share)
Unit tests with known inputs/outputs
userStories.notes: Pure calculation, no OnchainOS calls needed here

userStories.title: AI Roast: Report & speech generator
userStories.description: Generate the 'AI Judge Speech' roast commentary and format the complete breakup compensation report for display.
acceptanceCriteria: Function: generateRoast(walletData, compensationResult) → roast text string
Roast templates based on: high win rate, losses, meme-only portfolio, stablecoin-only portfolio, zero activity
Function: formatReport(walletData, scores, compensation, roast) → structured report object
Report includes: WANTED poster data, compensation notice data, share card data
Edge case handling: $0 compensation → '窮到連補償金都算不出' with instant noodle icon
Self-scan detection → easter egg message
userStories.notes: LLM-generated roast is optional; template-based roast is sufficient for MVP

userStories.title: ExChain Lock: Smart contract — ExChainLock.sol
userStories.description: Write and test the ExChainLock Solidity smart contract that handles dual-party USDC deposits, time-locked commitments, and breakup distribution.
acceptanceCriteria: Contract: ExChainLock with partyA, partyB, amountA, amountB, deadline, splitRatio
deposit() — each party deposits USDC (ERC20, not ETH)
renew(newDeadline) — requires both parties' signatures (2/2 multisig)
withdraw() — after deadline, each party gets back their deposit (default splitRatio 10000)
breakup() — distributes total pool by splitRatio (basis points)
24-hour timeout: if only one party deposits, auto-refund after 24 hours
Emergency: both parties can co-sign to early-exit before deadline
ReentrancyGuard on all external call functions
Use SafeERC20 for USDC transfers (not raw transfer)
Hardhat setup with compilation and basic test suite
Tests cover: happy path deposit→withdraw, breakup distribution, single-deposit timeout, renew, early exit
userStories.notes: Use USDC (ERC20), NOT ETH. Include ReentrancyGuard. Use call pattern not transfer.

userStories.title: ExChain Lock: Contract deployment via OnchainOS
userStories.description: Build the agent module that deploys ExChainLock contract and handles deposit flows using OnchainOS wallet & gateway skills.
acceptanceCriteria: Function: deployLockContract(params) using okx-agentic-wallet contract-call
Function: depositUSDC(contractAddr, amount) using okx-agentic-wallet send
Pre-deployment flow: estimate-gas → simulate-tx → security tx-scan → broadcast-tx
Status tracking: poll broadcast-tx until confirmed
Error handling: deployment failure, gas estimation failure, security scan warnings
Contract bytecode compilation integrated into build step
userStories.notes: Depends on US-006 contract being ready

userStories.title: Agent CLI: End-to-end interactive flow
userStories.description: Create the main agent entry point that ties everything together into an interactive CLI flow matching the PRD user stories (Flow A: scan + calculate + roast, Flow B: create lock).
acceptanceCriteria: CLI command: exchain scan <address> --from <date> --to <date> runs full Flow A
CLI command: exchain lock --amount <USDC> --duration <months> --template <peace|negotiate|punish|custom> runs Flow B
Scan flow: wallet scan → scoring → compensation calc → roast → formatted output
Lock flow: parameter setup → contract deploy → party A deposit → wait for party B → confirmation
Progress indicators during API calls (not silent waiting)
Edge cases handled: invalid address, empty wallet, API errors, self-scan easter egg
userStories.notes: This is the demo-ready integration story

userStories.title: Relationship Certificate NFT contract
userStories.description: Create a simple ERC721 contract that mints a 'Relationship Certificate' NFT when ExChain Lock is activated. NFT includes both parties' addresses, lock amount, and deadline.
acceptanceCriteria: ERC721 contract: ExChainCertificate with tokenURI pointing to on-chain metadata
Auto-mint on Lock activation (called by ExChainLock contract)
Metadata: partyA, partyB, totalLocked, deadline, createdAt
Upgrade mechanic placeholder: renewal updates token level (bronze→silver→gold→diamond)
Basic Hardhat tests for mint and metadata
userStories.notes: P1 for hackathon — nice-to-have, skip if time is tight

userStories.title: Share card image generation
userStories.description: Generate shareable breakup report images (1200×675) for social media using HTML/CSS template rendered to image.
acceptanceCriteria: HTML template for 'WANTED' poster and 'Compensation Notice' share cards
Dynamic content injection: wallet data, scores, compensation, roast
Output: PNG image file at standard social media ratio (1200×675)
Background color gradient based on compensation amount: $0 gray → $1K pink → $5K red → $10K+ gold
Address masking: show first 6 + last 4 chars only
ExChain branding: logo + slogan at bottom of every card
userStories.notes: P2 for hackathon — if time allows, this drives viral sharing
